reduceIf.confirmation: A 1H CLOSE below $63,300, which is under the 699.96K liquidation pool at 63,317.82 that is now the nearest heavy object beneath spot. Note what sits ABOVE that pool: the CoinGlass surface reads literally ZERO leverage at 63,809.15 and 63,668.77 and only 68.93K at 63,458.20. That is a 350-point air pocket directly under the market, so an intraday slip through 63,800 is meaningless noise and will travel fast - the level that actually matters is 63,300, because losing it on a closing basis means the 699.96K and the 440.59K at 63,177.44 have both been eaten and the next real floor is the 618.41K magnet at 62,124.59.

addIf.confirmation: SECOND tranche only, and only on a flush into the 618.41K magnet at 62,124.59 that HOLDS - a 15m close back above 62,150 after the tag, not a knife caught mid-fall. That pool is the heaviest object below spot and it has now survived five consecutive reports unconsumed while drifting 140 points lower (62,264.97 at midnight, 62,124.59 now). Roughly 12 USDT of cash stays reserved for exactly that event after this morning's small tranche.

decisionBox.changed: POSITION IS UNCHANGED AT ADD, but the reasoning has shifted from momentum to macro and the size is smaller. Four things moved since 02:00. ONE, the liquidity map got MORE lopsided upward: the dominant pool above grew from 950.94K at 64,300.48 to 1.12M at 64,370.67, which is 96.6% of the 1.16M colour maximum and the single brightest cell anywhere on the 48h surface. TWO, the 396.27K shelf that sat just under spot at midnight has DISSOLVED - 63,458.20 now reads only 68.93K and the two cells above it read zero - and the mass migrated down into 699.96K at 63,317.82 plus 440.59K at 63,177.44, so the nearest downside cushion moved 70 points further away and the tape between here and there is empty. THREE, macro eased hard: Brent collapsed 2.95% to 81.30, the US 10-year fell to 4.659%, the dollar index is flat at 99.916, and US equity pre-market is strongly bid with QQQ indicated +1.09% at 707.67. FOUR, price is pressing the daily EMA20 at 63,971.46 for the third time in a day and has not closed above it. That last point is why the tranche is 8 USDT and not 15: the evidence supports being long, the chart has not yet confirmed it.

Empty tape cuts both ways: it is why a dip here accelerates, and it is why a dip here means nothing until it reaches 63,318.

699.96K, tooltip-verified. The nearest heavy pool beneath spot at -0.85%, and it is NEW - at midnight the equivalent object was 396.27K at 63,388.01. Mass has both grown and migrated 70 points lower. It is the reason the reduce trigger sits at 63,300 rather than anywhere higher.

440.59K, tooltip-verified. Stacked 140 points under the 699.96K pool, so 63,177-63,318 is effectively one 1.14M band. Both would have to be consumed before the 62,125 magnet comes into range, which is what makes the 63,300 reduce level a real line rather than a stop-hunt donation.
307.62K, tooltip-verified. A mid-sized station on the way down, thin enough that it slows a flush rather than stopping one.

Leverage below spot is LONG liquidation, so a tag there is a stop-run into forced selling and the reason the add trigger requires a 15m close back ABOVE 62,150 rather than a limit bid sitting in the pool.
172.42K, tooltip-verified. Much lighter than the magnet above it, which continues to argue that 62,125 is a floor to trade against rather than the entrance to a cascade.

liquidityMagnet.note: Pull is UP and it is now the most one-sided reading this desk has recorded. Weigh the two by size and distance: 1.12M sitting 0.80% above versus 699.96K sitting 0.85% below - the upside pool is 60% larger at essentially identical distance. Add the 350-point air pocket immediately under spot and the arithmetic is plain: a downside probe has nothing to feed on until 63,318, while an upside probe walks into the biggest cell on the map. The honest caveat is that price has now been rejected three times in the 63,949-64,240 shelf and the daily EMA20 at 63,971.46 has capped every one of those attempts, so the map says where, not when.

calibration.rollingRecord: The 02:00 COT midnight report called range with a bullish tilt at 42/38/20 and moved from HOLD to ADD, buying 15 USDT of spot at 63,639.4. Five hours later that call is working. Spot is 63,858.8, +0.34%, so the tranche is in profit and the 0.00279094 BTC core has gained about 0.61 USDT of mark value. Its reduce trigger at 63,340 did NOT fire - the session low was 63,466.4, leaving 126.4 points of clearance, the tightest margin of the last four sessions but still clean. Its second-tranche add trigger at 62,300 was never approached. Where midnight was RIGHT: it argued that the endday report's error was waiting for a flush that never came, and it was right again - no flush came this session either, and a desk that had held out for 62,300 would have watched another 220 points of drift from the sidelines. Where midnight was INCOMPLETE: it read the 396.27K shelf at 63,388 as the immediate downside risk, and that shelf has since dissolved rather than been tested - the mass migrated 70 points lower into a bigger 699.96K pool. The lesson carrying forward is that heatmap cells decay and reform faster than price moves, so a level read five hours ago needs re-reading rather than re-quoting.
